owner_and_capability: Care Plan — the public modules/careplan decision error contract for offering-change, course-request, pickup-adjustment and offering-adjustment decisions (decision_errors.go), which api/students and the parent inbound handlers now map instead of the services/enrollment and models/enrollment values (#3558)
atomic_cutover: One PR defines the owner error values in modules/careplan with texts byte-identical to the legacy values, points the services/enrollment names at them, and switches every api/students mapping to the owner values. models/enrollment may not import Care Plan, so services/enrollment returns not-found and not-pending errors that match both the owner value and the legacy name. The offering-change not-found and not-pending mappings were the last production uses of models/enrollment in api/students, which retires the listed key. No statement, no table access and no second provider is added.
tests: scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast: the full suites of every changed package, including api/students, services/enrollment, modules/careplan and workflows/parentportal.
api/students/care_plan_decision_errors_golden_test.go pins status, code and text of every mapped owner error.
modules/careplan/decision_errors_test.go pins every owner text; services/enrollment/care_plan_decision_errors_test.go pins that each legacy name matches its owner value under errors.Is.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check with the listed key absent from legacy.jsonl.
